title: Explicit operator-only operation grants
why: Actions, transitions and operations can require a verified operator-issued system key independently of roles. Roles named system, owner or admin do not acquire that authority and nested steps cannot broaden it.
changelog: Explicit systemOnly grants protect actions, transitions and operations
